exposure: prenatal diagnosis of fetal growth restriction
outcome: incidence of morbidity due to various respiratory conditions
cohort: 324,620 deliveries of appropriate for gestational age (AGA) singletons between 1991 and 2021 at a tertiary referral hospital
finding: Appropriate for gestational age (AGA) newborns misclassified as growth-restricted prenatally are at an increased risk for long-term respiratory morbidity during childhood and adolescence.
gest_age: AGA, with a subset misclassified as growth-restricted prenatally
